components.label: Wheeler River Phoenix ISR project (probability-weighted NPV)
components.ownership_claim: 95% interest in Phoenix ISR post-tax NPV after probability and timing discount
components.evidence: Phoenix feasibility economics incorporated by reference in Form 40-F FY2025 (Exhibits 99.1-99.3 not in admitted evidence packet). Base applies P=0.55 and timing discount to ~95% project interest on adjusted post-tax NPV ~USD 1.48B (June 2023 FS, company disclosure) [Assumption].
components.scenario_assumptions: Binary milestone: provincial permits and FID gate value.

probability_and_timing.timing_basis: Seven-year horizon; value recognized as FID/construction milestones advance, not as current owner cash.
probability_and_timing.probability_basis: Base case P=0.55 on Phoenix FID by 2028; low case P=0.25 with delay; high case P=0.75 with early FID.
probability_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: Construction capex and equity raises before first production are charged in scenario payoffs, not as a separate additive row.

components.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Binary milestone: provincial permits and FID gate value.
components.falsifier: Phoenix ISR permits denied or FID pushed beyond 2029 without financing path.

components.label: Wheeler River Gryphon conventional option
components.ownership_claim: Follow-on Gryphon conventional mine option after Phoenix
components.evidence: Gryphon PFS update economics incorporated by reference (40-F FY2025); base P=0.25 on ~95% of post-tax NPV ~USD 821M with deferral discount [Assumption].
components.scenario_assumptions: Follow-on phase after Phoenix; zero in bear.

probability_and_timing.timing_basis: Deferred past Phoenix FID; no value in first five years in base case.
probability_and_timing.probability_basis: Base P=0.25; high P=0.45 if Phoenix funds Gryphon; low P=0.0 if shelved.
probability_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: Gryphon capex not modeled separately; absorbed in consolidated scenario payoffs.

components.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Zero in bear scenario; follows Phoenix success.
components.falsifier: The next decision milestone fails, remaining capital rises materially, or the stated success probability no longer fits observable progress.

method_fit.label: Scarce assets, royalties, and optionality
applicability_tests: The security owns a legally enforceable economic claim on scarce assets or royalties.
Material value is omitted or poorly represented by current GAAP earnings.
Asset quantities, ownership, overlap, timing, and remaining capital can be reconciled.
Comparable values can be adjusted for location, quality, control, liquidity, and realization time.
failure_modes: gross asset value mistaken for shareholder value
operating cash flow and NAV counted twice
remote options treated as contracted cash

validation_cohort.purpose: Test depletion, commodity exposure, finite reserves, and royalty-unit reconciliation.
Test tangible capital, credit losses, funding, regulation, and excess-capital realization.
Test owner earnings, capital-light reinvestment, cyclicality, and buyback value creation.
Test normalized margins, industry supply response, replacement cost, and reinvestment timing.
Test product concentration, pipeline probabilities, patent cliffs, and catalyst timing.

method_fit.rule: Use one primary method and no more than two corroborating methods; irrelevant methods and personas remain silent.

outcomes.weighting_rule: Do not change a persona's relevance within a power zone until at least 20 attributable, dividend-aware outcomes exist there; never reweight automatically.

attribution.explanation: A complete security value is intentionally withheld while material components are unpriced. Attribution restarts after the first proof-complete baseline.
